What we make & install

Aluminium products for homes and businesses

  • Windows

    Aluminium Windows & Door Frames

    Top-hung, side-hung and fixed windows with matching frames, made to your openings.

  • Doors

    Aluminium Doors

    Single and double hinged doors for entrances, patios and offices.

  • Doors

    Folding & Sliding Doors

    Wide openings that connect indoor and outdoor living without taking up floor space.

  • Garage

    Garage Doors

    Aluminium garage doors in modern glazed and solid finishes.

  • Gates & fencing

    Aluminium Gates

    Driveway and pedestrian gates, with matching slatted fencing for a uniform boundary.

  • Stairs & balconies

    Balustrades

    Glass and aluminium balustrades for staircases, balconies and landings.

  • Security

    Aluminium Burglar Bars

    Rust-free burglar bars that secure windows and doors and match your frames.

  • Commercial

    Aluminium Shop Fronts

    Shop fronts, entrance doors and glass partitions for retail and office spaces.

  • Fabrication

    Custom Aluminium Fabrication

    One-off aluminium work built to your measurements and drawings.

  • Outdoor

    Shade Structures, Pergolas & Carports

    Louvred patio shades, pergolas and carports for homes and businesses.

Who we are

About Rivoni Holdings

Rivoni Holdings is an aluminium fabrication and installation business based in Vereeniging, Gauteng. We provide aluminium solutions for residential and commercial properties, including windows, doors, folding and sliding doors, garage doors, gates, balustrades, burglar bars and shop fronts.

Our focus is on practical solutions tailored to customer requirements.
